gateAttempts.correction: Added panel shrink and measured text row heights to constrain the selected panel and natural font extents. Tagged text inspection now propagates styled ancestor visibility while still requiring label presence and the Bool false-to-true behavior.

Gate-02 rejected duplicate region-root sizing, requiring Build-05 and Gate-03 alongside a repeat-test return guard. Gate-03 then exposed panel overflow, insufficient natural-font row heights and a local-only visibility fixture; their correction required Build-06 and one fresh Gate-04.

art.mockReferenceRole: illustrative design reference; not runtime evidence
art.backdropRole: art-only texture; authored native widgets supply interface text and controls

scope: Reflected flat collection admission, atomic keyed publication, native reorder correction, and a registered AngelScript Mission Board PIE consumer, with focused compatible collection/repeat/table/session/font/menu coverage.
capabilities: Reflected flat records support Text, Number, Bool, Integer and Color fields with stable keys.
Schema and record admission rejects malformed input atomically; corrected publication can retry.
Pure reorder installs requested order and advances revision with one notification while retaining keyed row state.
The actual registered AngelScript Mission Board mounts, selects, completes, reorders, removes, reinserts, reloads and clears collection-driven rows and scalar details.
Native capture assertions and visual inspection cover initial resolution scaling plus selected, completed and empty states.
Focused compatible tests cover native batch/nested publication, repeat failure/retention/action paths, table reload, session lifetime and earlier font/menu consumers.
limitations: The reflected collection boundary supports five flat field kinds; Image fields and reflected nested child collections are unsupported.
Native nested collection sibling tests do not establish reflected nested collection support.
Ordinary buttons are recreated during repeat refresh; keyed root, search and custom-widget retention are distinct checks. Focus continuity across refresh remains unproven.
No virtualization or large-list screen performance claim is made.
Controller navigation and packaged/installed-plugin acceptance remain unverified.
The generated reference is illustrative; runtime captures show authored native controls over an art-only backdrop.
The 32-test focused population is not repository-wide regression coverage.
